IRAN'S IRGC WARNS THE US AND COUNTRIES HOSTING ITS BASES, SAYING FURTHER ATTACKS ON IRAN WILL TRIGGER "MORE CRUSHING" RETALIATION

Tehran's Revolutionary Guard Corps has issued a stark warning to the United States and any nation harboring American military installations in the region. In a strongly worded statement, the IRGC declared that any further aggression against Iran will be met with an “even more crushing” response.

The message underscores heightened tensions amid ongoing regional instability, signaling Iran’s readiness to escalate its defense posture if provoked. The guards emphasized that their patience has limits—and crossing red lines will come at a cost.
